## Methods

Agreement between new_assay and reference_assay was assessed by the method of Bland and Altman (n = 40 pairs). The mean difference (new_assay - reference_assay) was 5.93 (95% CI 4.42 to 7.45) with a standard deviation of 4.74. The 95% limits of agreement were -3.36 (95% CI -5.97 to -0.744) and 15.2 (95% CI 12.6 to 17.8), computed as the mean difference plus or minus 1.96 standard deviations, with confidence intervals from the standard error of Bland and Altman (1999). A linear regression of the difference on the mean gave a slope of 0.045 (P = 0.0010) as a test of proportional bias. The normality of the differences, which the limits assume, was checked with the Shapiro-Wilk test (P = 0.67). Computed in R 4.4.1 and drawn with ggplot2 3.5.1.
